protocol.same_archive: One frozen archive per case, same SHA for both policies and every restore
protocol.timing: Fresh phase process; excludes Python startup and external byte comparison. Includes unpack/verification/file sync/publish (including bounded Windows rename retries)/temp cleanup.
protocol.failures: All failed jobs retained; no whole-restore retries. Timing summaries use successful jobs only; paired statistics require both policies succeed in the round.
protocol.ordering: All case/policy/round jobs shuffled after shuffled warmups; independent staging directory per restore
protocol.cache: Archive hash pre-read outside timing, warm OS cache; no device cache eviction or background-load isolation
protocol.persistence: files: file SHA, flush, fsync, close, all-files-complete then directory rename. close: file SHA then close; same remaining path.
protocol.limits: File sync requests are not a directory/volume/controller power-loss proof. No directory fsync or automatic orphan recovery.
